text:
alex kim: Quick sync: proposing a "cohort health probe" for safe config rollouts. idea: during ramp, emit a cold-path probe + cohort tags and run small sampled requests to check real latency. dry-run tomorrow 09:30 UTC.

maria gonzalez: love it. what's probe rate? and where does it appear in console?

alex kim: probe = 1% of cohort traffic or min 5 r/s. tag with `telemetry.cohort=NAME` + `health_probe=true`. console tile: small table per cohort with probe lat95, error-rate, cache_hit_ratio.

jon rao: auto-stop rule: if probe lat95 > SLO or probe errors > 3x baseline -> pause next ramp step. need deterministic cohort assignment by user-id hash.

tara li: console needs one-click pause + link to playbook. audit entry for every cohort activation with commit id + operator.

kevin ng: note: prefix cache makes probes tricky. make probes hit cold prefixes or bypass cache. also monitor kv_eviction_rate and unique-kv-hit-rate.

alex kim: good call. probes routed to cold-paths; if not possible, tag and sample cold requests separately. I'll add `probe_route=cold` flag.

deploy-bot: scheduled job created: "cohort-health-probe-dryrun" -> staging at 1777779000.

maria gonzalez: i'll sketch console mock and add cumulative progress + per-cohort sparkline.

jon rao: preflight checklist: perf test, telemetry wiring, console tiles, rollback playbook, notify support.

alex kim: will update RFC & PR. pinging everyone when job starts. thanks.
